display_long_description:
RealmCraft is a fully immersive 3D sandbox adventure game set in a cubic world, where VR gameplay blends creativity and survival.
Explore a vast open world, mine resources, craft gear, and build anything you can imagine – all from a true first-person perspective that brings your creations to life. [media]
Venture through towering mountains, mysterious caves, and wild landscapes uncovering secrets in a procedurally generated world. [media]
Embark on mining expeditions, gather rare materials, craft tools and weapons, manage hunger, build shelters, and battle dangerous creatures. [media]
In Creative Mode, build without limits. No threats. No restrictions. Just pure imagination in a world that’s entirely yours to shape.[media]
Whether crafting a perfect home, surviving the unknown, or losing yourself in a blocky VR universe – RealmCraft is built to inspire and designed for immersive exploration.[media]
Key Features:
 • Immersive 3D sandbox with first-person VR gameplay
 • Massive, procedurally generated open world
 • Mining, crafting, building, survival mechanics
 • Total freedom in Creative Mode
 • Explore deep caves and epic landscapes
 • Battle hostile creatures and find hidden treasures
 • Optimized for smooth, intuitive VR interaction
[media]
RealmCraft VR is an original game developed from scratch, inspired by the sandbox gameplay popularized by Minecraft. All code, models, textures, and other assets are independently created. This project is not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by Mojang or Microsoft.
